closure_scope.not_claimed: Global completeness of the infinite rotor, or geometric closure for arbitrary initial spin near the window boundary.
closure_scope.direct_crosscheck: Build all five lab Q components by Wigner-Eckart in the complete magnetic finite-window representation, without 6j coefficients; contract at M=1/2 and stretched M=11/2.
closure_scope.operator_identity: Check initial-I M=1/2 block of QdotQ=1 and normalized cubic=cos(3gamma)*1 in the D2 coordinate basis, before selecting eigenstates.
